limitations: The q=9 threshold is exact only in the stated core-periphery family of symmetric aversion-to-enemies games; no smallest counterexample among all bipartite enemy graphs is established. Exact optimization does not imply arbitrary-game tractability, strategic equilibrium, or alternative utility-normalization results.
scientific_integrity: Analytic proof of infinite family with independent finite consistency checks; no independent external scientific audit or certification.
title: Sharp three-coalition transition in bipartite-enemy Nash welfare games
